title: 第24课 · 你什么时候回国
subtitle: Lesson 24 — 你什么时候回国 · When are you going back

items.en: to return to one's country
about to; going to (soon)
time
progress; to improve
reluctant to part with
to leave
to continue
to feel; to think
short (time/length)
fast; soon; almost
to graduate
experience
to forget
to contact; to keep in touch
When are you going back to your country?

items.py: Wǒ xià ge yuè jiù yào huí guó le.
items.en: I'll be going home next month.
Time flies!

items.zh: 你在中国学了多长时间？
items.py: Nǐ zài Zhōngguó xué le duō cháng shíjiān?
items.en: How long have you studied in China?

items.py: Nǐ shě bu de líkāi ma?
items.en: Are you reluctant to leave?

items.py: Wǒ zhēn shě bu de líkāi zhèr.
items.en: I'm really reluctant to leave here.

items.zh: 张老师：大卫，你什么时候回国？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Dàwèi, nǐ shénme shíhou huí guó?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: David, when are you going home?

items.zh: 大卫：下个月就要回国了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Xià ge yuè jiù yào huí guó le.
items.en: David: I'll be going back next month.

items.zh: 张老师：时间过得真快！你在中国学了多长时间？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài! Nǐ zài Zhōngguó xué le duō cháng shíjiān?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Time flies! How long have you studied in China?
David: Almost a year.

items.zh: 张老师：你的汉语进步很大。
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Nǐ de Hànyǔ jìnbù hěn dà.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Your Chinese has improved a lot.

items.zh: 大卫：谢谢老师。我真舍不得离开这儿。
items.py: Dàwèi: Xièxie lǎoshī. Wǒ zhēn shě bu de líkāi zhèr.
items.en: David: Thank you, teacher. I'm really reluctant to leave.

items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Huānyíng nǐ zài lái!
items.en: Teacher Zhang: You're welcome to come again!

items.zh: 玛丽：和子，你也快要回国了吧？
items.py: Mǎlì: Hézǐ, nǐ yě kuài yào huí guó le ba?
items.en: Mary: Hezi, you're also going home soon, right?

items.zh: 和子：是的，还有两个星期。
items.py: Hézǐ: Shì de, hái yǒu liǎng ge xīngqī.
items.en: Hezi: Yes, two more weeks.

items.zh: 玛丽：回国以后你打算做什么？
items.py: Mǎlì: Huí guó yǐhòu nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
items.en: Mary: What do you plan to do after going back?

items.zh: 和子：我打算继续学汉语。
items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ dǎsuàn jìxù xué Hànyǔ.
items.en: Hezi: I plan to continue studying Chinese.

items.zh: 玛丽：我在中国的时间太短了。
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ zài Zhōngguó de shíjiān tài duǎn le.
items.en: Mary: My time in China was too short.

items.zh: 和子：是啊，我也觉得时间不够用。
items.py: Hézǐ: Shì a, wǒ yě juéde shíjiān bú gòu yòng.
items.en: Hezi: Yes, I also feel there isn't enough time.

items.zh: 玛丽：我一定会再来中国的。
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ yīdìng huì zài lái Zhōngguó de.
items.en: Mary: I'll definitely come back to China.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (就要/快要...了 Imminent Future)

items.py: Wǒ jiù yào huí guó le.
items.en: I'm about to go home. (就要...了 = imminent)
It's about to rain. (快要...了 = very soon)
He's about to graduate.
The plane is about to take off.
The exam is about to begin.

items.py: Wǒ jiù yào huí guó le.
items.en: I'm about to go home.
He's about to graduate.
Spring Festival is almost here.
The movie is about to start.

items.zh: 回国以后你打算做什么？
items.py: Huí guó yǐhòu nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
items.en: What do you plan to do after going home?

items.zh: 毕业以后你打算做什么？
items.py: Bìyè yǐhòu nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
items.en: What do you plan to do after graduating?
